name: Omacube
author: Tiedeyez
description: An animated desktop background of endlessly nested 3x3 puzzle cubes. The view dives forever into a cube corner where every corner piece is another whole cube; each cube scrambles itself with real layer turns and then solves itself, inside a drifting field of tumbling cubes. Switching workspaces twists the view 120 degrees and dives one level deeper. One GPU fragment shader, no files, processes or network.
